settings.seed_control: single-panel arm rerun with sampler seed 2000 + rep (main runs use 1000 + rep)
settings.uncertainty: mean over replicates, percentile bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples of replicates, seed 20261105)

metric_definitions.ld_fit_excess: Gaussian LD-fit loss (ridge delta 0.001) of the arm's LD matrix to the generating covariance of the null z-scores, minus the loss at the generating weight; per replicate, then averaged
metric_definitions.null_score_var_pct: 100 * (variance of target scores / variance under EUR-only PRS-CS - 1), null GWAS, paired by replicate
metric_definitions.top10_overlap_pct: share of target individuals in the arm's top score decile who are also in EUR-only PRS-CS's top decile, non-null GWAS
metric_definitions.r2: squared correlation between target scores and true genetic values, non-null GWAS

notes: Replicates missing an arm are dropped from that arm's paired comparisons; n_rep per cell is in tables.tsv. Experiment runs were made on RedHawk with the null-simulation job scripts (cluster/jobs/null_sim, not version-controlled).
